providerNeutralRule: These sheets describe form, scale, materials, and view intent for any rights-cleared manual or automated 3D authoring workflow. They contain no Hunyuan-specific input or output requirement.
rightsBoundary: The sheets are internal modeling references, not public runtime assets. They inherit a publication hold because the Carlos-supplied mainUI reference has no recorded underlying authorship or generation history yet.
globalNegativeConstraints: No baked website UI, words, letters, numerals, pseudo-writing, logos, trademarks, or watermarks.
No blue neon, violet, cyan glow, black sci-fi void, glossy generic consumer electronics, or unrelated cyberpunk styling.
No public runtime use until source rights, output provenance, likeness risk, and asset-specific publication approval pass task 2.25.

negativeConstraints: No sealed dark dome or opaque roof.
No ornamental fantasy architecture or impossible unsupported arches.
assets.modelingNotes: Keep the circular oculus, readable arched bays, shallow basin clearance, and broad calm floor plane. Build repeatable wall and shelf modules before adding props.

negativeConstraints: No deep pool, waterfall, foam, or ocean surface.
No baked high-frequency ripple texture or mirror-like chrome water.
assets.modelingNotes: Author one shallow two-triangle runtime surface inside a low stepped stone ring. The image defines color, rim profile, and ripple scale rather than shader implementation.

negativeConstraints: No human skin, projected face, weapon, wings, extra limbs, or aggressive military silhouette.
No glossy white consumer-electronics finish or exposed cables without mechanical purpose.
assets.modelingNotes: Use the four views to preserve one silhouette and joint hierarchy. Five-finger hand topology, water-contact reach, stable kneel pose, and animation deformation require manual review.

negativeConstraints: No weapon mounts, military camouflage, anthropomorphic face, or exposed dangerous blades.
No blue status lights, neon trails, or continuous fast hovering motion.
assets.modelingNotes: Keep a compact central camera body, four protected rotors, balanced arm length, and a stable frozen hover pose for reduced motion.

negativeConstraints: No zodiac glyphs, pseudo-writing, proprietary symbols, or magical particles.
No dense unreadable engraving or screen-based interface.
assets.modelingNotes: Model a tilted astrolabe-like assembly with concentric rings, radial lines, round fasteners, a central pivot, and a mechanically plausible walnut support.

negativeConstraints: No numerals, pseudo-writing, divination claims, glowing runes, or magical effects.
No loose markers that lack a stable track or collision-safe rest position.
assets.modelingNotes: Use a low circular body, concentric construction grooves, and one restrained ring of movable wooden markers. Selection motion must remain bounded and legible.

negativeConstraints: No keyboard, DJ-brand mimicry, words, waveform baked into geometry, or autoplay implication.
No dense wall of controls, nightclub neon, or rapid flashing indicator array.
assets.modelingNotes: Keep one central circular harmonic dial with a restrained set of tactile knobs and sliders. The visual must remain useful when audio and motion are unavailable.

negativeConstraints: No oil-industry branding, impossible pipe terminations, pressure-unsafe exposed glass, or medical-device styling.
No emissive fantasy liquid, blue glow, pseudo-scientific labels, or implied performance metric.
assets.modelingNotes: Preserve two protected reservoirs, a legible closed pipe loop, pump housings, a central service panel, and a low wood/metal base. Liquid motion is a later runtime effect.

negativeConstraints: No proprietary board logo, brand-identifiable device copy, pseudo-writing, or live data screen.
No exposed hazardous mains wiring, excessive cable clutter, or blinking indicator wall.
assets.modelingNotes: Build a compact horizontal chassis with modular boards behind protective grilles, tactile controls, cable sockets, cooling detail, and one blank status window.

negativeConstraints: No branded books, readable labels, rare identifiable specimens, or clutter that competes with navigation.
No high-poly leaf cards, alpha-heavy forest density, or animated foliage.
assets.modelingNotes: Author a small reusable kit of shelves, workbench, stool, pots, low-detail plants, bottles, and one neutral armillary prop. Instance repeated pieces.

negativeConstraints: No blue moonlight, violet fill, neon rim, black background, or blown-out white oculus.

assets.modelingNotes: Reproduce the exposure with runtime-authored warm key light, soft neutral fill, restrained contact shadows, and a transparent no-HDR environment until rights are cleared.
